# petals: product identity

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Product | petals |
| Tagline | Brand that agents read. |
| Positioning | A design assist for coding agents: it informs how the agent designs inside your brand before a line is generated, and audits what came out after. |

## Mark

One petal held between two leaves: the brand carried into what grows. The three shapes are
ink (`#1C1610`) on a rounded accent plate (`#CC6A37`), in both the paper and the soil-night
files. The mark is drawn in the umbrella and arrives with the brand at v1.9.0.

Files: `assets/petals-mark.svg` (paper) · `assets/petals-mark-night.svg` (soil-night).

## Logo usage

- Copy the files byte for byte. Never redraw, trace or approximate the paths.
- Fills are exact: ink `#1C1610` on accent `#CC6A37`. Never recolour.
- Clear space: half the mark height on every side.
- The wordmark is lowercase "petals", set whole, never title-cased.
